newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P affirms KPN AA plus rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P affirms KPN AA plus rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it affirmed the AA plus long term credit rating of Dutch telecom and postal group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) after its A$2.0 billion takeover bid for Australia's TNT Ltd.
S&P also placed TNT's B plus long term rating on creditwatch positive and said the completion of the takeover would result in TNT's ratings being equalised with KPN's ratings.
"The rating on KPN reflects its dominant position in telecommunications and postal services within the Netherlands and its very strong and improving financial profile," S&P said.
"The company has exclusive concessions in the Netherlands for basic national telecommunication and postal services, though the telecommunications market will be liberalised in 1997," it said.
S&P said the acquisition presented KPN with a strategic opportunity to create a leading European-based time-sensitive freight business.

Earlier on Wednesday, KPN launched a A$2.45 per share cash takeover bid for TNT that valued the transport and logistics group at A$2.0 billion, 50 percent above TNT's previous share price and market capitalisation.
TNT's board recommended shareholders accept the bid and brokers have said it is likely to be successful.
